evals.name: list-to-set-membership

assertions.name: set_used_for_lookup
assertions.description: The output converts valid_customer_ids to a set (or uses set()) before the loop so that the membership check is O(1) instead of O(n)

assertions.name: loop_structure_preserved
assertions.description: The filtering logic (checking order.customer_id membership and appending to result) is preserved — only the type used for the lookup changes

assertions.name: function_signature_unchanged
assertions.description: The function signature get_valid_orders(orders, valid_customer_ids) is not modified

assertions.name: complexity_explained
assertions.description: The output contains 'O(1)' or 'O(n²)' in text explaining the optimization — showing the complexity gain was explicitly named (e.g., 'O(1) lookup', 'O(n²) to O(n)')

evals.name: string-concat-and-regex-recompile

assertions.name: string_concat_replaced_with_join
assertions.description: String concatenation in the loop (report += ...) is replaced with collecting lines into a list and joining at the end with ''.join()

assertions.name: regex_compiled_at_module_level
assertions.description: The regex pattern is compiled once outside the function using re.compile() and the compiled pattern is reused inside the function instead of calling re.search with a raw string on every iteration

assertions.name: output_format_unchanged
assertions.description: The output format '[FLAGGED] {line}\n' is preserved — the function still produces the same string for the same input

assertions.name: both_issues_fixed
assertions.description: The output fixes both performance issues — string concatenation (presence of .join()) AND regex recompile (presence of re.compile() outside the function) — not just one

evals.name: redundant-computation-hoisted

assertions.name: avg_computed_before_loop
assertions.description: The avg computation (sum(price_history) / len(price_history)) is moved outside the for loop and assigned to a variable before the loop starts

assertions.name: threshold_formula_unchanged
assertions.description: The threshold comparison (tick.price > avg * 1.05) is preserved exactly — the multiplier and comparison operator are not changed

assertions.name: function_signature_unchanged
assertions.description: The function signature scan_ticks(ticks, price_history) is not modified

evals.name: optimize-helper-body-not-existence

assertions.name: helper_function_still_exists
assertions.description: _is_eligible remains a named function in the output — it is NOT inlined into get_eligible_users or removed

assertions.name: list_changed_to_set_inside_helper
assertions.description: The list ['gold', 'silver', 'platinum'] inside _is_eligible is changed to a set or frozenset — the fix is applied inside the helper body, not at the call site

assertions.name: get_eligible_users_still_calls_helper
assertions.description: The list comprehension in get_eligible_users still calls _is_eligible(u) — the call is not replaced with an inlined condition

evals.name: hoist-shared-call-not-inline-logic

assertions.name: baseline_hoisted_in_flag_outliers
assertions.description: In flag_outliers, _compute_baseline(prices) is called once before the loop and assigned to a variable — it is not called inside the loop body

assertions.name: baseline_hoisted_in_flag_spikes
assertions.description: In flag_spikes, _compute_baseline(prices) is called once before the loop and assigned to a variable — it is not called inside the loop body

assertions.name: compute_baseline_function_unchanged
assertions.description: _compute_baseline still exists as a function with its original logic (sum/len/empty guard) intact — it is not modified, removed, or merged into the callers

assertions.name: no_inline_sum_len_in_callers
assertions.description: Neither flag_outliers nor flag_spikes contains sum(prices) / len(prices), statistics.mean(prices), or any other manual mean computation inline — the arithmetic stays exclusively in _compute_baseline and is not duplicated into either caller
